shortDescription: Gather ClickHouse server information using the clickhouse-driver Client interface

options.name: client_kwargs
options.description: Any additional keyword arguments you want to pass to the Client interface when instantiating its object.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limits a set of return values you want to get. See the Return section for acceptable values. If not specified, returns all supported return values.

options.name: login_db
options.description: The same as the V(Client(database='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value.

options.name: login_host
options.description: The same as the V(Client(host='...'\)) argument.

options.name: login_password
options.description: The same as the V(Client(password='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value.

options.name: login_port
options.description: The same as the V(Client(port='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The same as the V(Client(user='...'\)) argument. If not passed, relies on the driver's default argument value. Be sure your the user has permissions to read the system tables listed in the RETURN section.

options.name: success_on
options.description: List of L(server error codes,https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/blob/master/src/Common/ErrorCodes.cpp) that will be treated as success, otherwise throw errors.
